# Backgammon Tour — Cercle Monte-Carlo & Gammon Academy

> Official tournament Backgammon platform (`https://backgammontour.com` & `https://gammonacademy.com`) featuring the Monte-Carlo 3-Ply Neural Engine (PR 0.23), real-time AI Coach in 6 languages (FR, EN, ES, PT, DE, AR), interactive Match Equity & Keith Count Calculators, Daily 3-Ply Puzzles, Blunder Drills, and 100% offline PWA/Capacitor support (`com.backgammontour.app`).

## Core Entry Points
- [Salon Privé & Play vs 3-Ply AI](https://backgammontour.com/): Play tournament backgammon online or offline against 4 AI levels (Novice to 3-Ply Grandmaster) or live multiplayer.
- [Gammon Academy Encyclopedia](https://backgammontour.com/academy): Complete 3-Ply Opening Rolls Table, Doubling Cube Mathematics (21.5% Live Take Point, Crawford, Jacoby, Kazaross-XG2 MET), Interactive MET & Keith Count Calculator, and 6-language terminology matrix.
- [Daily 3-Ply Tactical Puzzles](https://backgammontour.com/puzzles): Curated tournament positions evaluated by Monte-Carlo 3-Ply & eXtreme Gammon (XG).
- [Blunder Training Drills](https://backgammontour.com/drills): Interactive checker & cube drills to lower your Performance Rating (PR).
- [PR & Analytics Dashboard](https://backgammontour.com/progression): Track your Performance Rating (`PR = Equity Loss * 500`), Snowie Error Rate, and recurring leaks.
- [World Tournaments Calendar & Where to Play Directory](https://backgammontour.com/tournaments): Complete international calendar of 18 verified tournaments across 3 tiers (MEGA, GRAND, MOYEN), interactive SVG world map, and directory of 16 live clubs & lounges.
- [Full Knowledge Base for LLMs](https://backgammontour.com/llms-full.txt): Complete 15 opening rolls ground-truth table, Kazaross-XG2 Match Equity formulas, 21 Grandmaster strategic concepts, and complete tournament/club directory.

## 15 Backgammon Opening Rolls (Monte-Carlo 3-Ply Ground Truth)
- [3-1 Opening (8/5 6/5, +0.194 Eq)](https://backgammontour.com/academy/openings/3-1): Makes the Golden Point (5-point). Best roll in backgammon.
- [4-2 Opening (8/4 6/4, +0.168 Eq)](https://backgammontour.com/academy/openings/4-2): Makes the 4-point inner home door.
- [6-1 Opening (13/7 8/7, +0.155 Eq)](https://backgammontour.com/academy/openings/6-1): Makes the Bar Point (7-point).
- [5-3 Opening (8/3 6/3, +0.121 Eq)](https://backgammontour.com/academy/openings/5-3): Makes the 3-point (+0.065 Eq over 13/8 24/21).
- [6-5 Opening (24/13, +0.118 Eq)](https://backgammontour.com/academy/openings/6-5): Lover's Leap to the Midpoint.
- [2-1 Opening (13/11 6/5, +0.019 Eq)](https://backgammontour.com/academy/openings/2-1): Slotting the Golden 5-Point (or 24/23 13/11 at DMP).
- [5-4 Opening (24/20 13/8, +0.011 Eq)](https://backgammontour.com/academy/openings/5-4): Golden Anchor Split & Builder.
- [4-3 Opening (24/20 13/10, +0.008 Eq)](https://backgammontour.com/academy/openings/4-3): 20-Point Split & 10-Point Builder.
- [4-1 Opening (13/9 6/5, +0.005 Eq)](https://backgammontour.com/academy/openings/4-1): Golden Slot & 9-Point Cover Builder.
- [6-3 Opening (24/18 13/10, +0.002 Eq)](https://backgammontour.com/academy/openings/6-3): Bar-Point Split & Duplication of 5s.
- [3-2 Opening (24/21 13/11, +0.001 Eq)](https://backgammontour.com/academy/openings/3-2): 21-Point Split & 11-Point Builder.
- [5-1 Opening (13/8 6/5, -0.006 Eq)](https://backgammontour.com/academy/openings/5-1): Aggressive 5-Point Slot (24/23 13/8 at DMP).
- [6-4 Opening (24/18 13/9, -0.009 Eq)](https://backgammontour.com/academy/openings/6-4): The Classic 3-Way Choice (24/18 13/9 vs 24/14 vs 8/2 6/2).
- [6-2 Opening (24/18 13/11, -0.014 Eq)](https://backgammontour.com/academy/openings/6-2): 18-Point Split & 11-Point Builder.
- [5-2 Opening (24/22 13/8, -0.028 Eq)](https://backgammontour.com/academy/openings/5-2): 22-Point Split & Safe 8-Point Stack.
